items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Doc Rando, who also played with Bob Crossby, came along playing alto sax.

ctx.x: Did you make up your own fingering pretty much or did you arrive at standard and fingering?

Well no, I did a lot of fake fingering, you know, which you have to do. Of course clarinet you have to finger more or less a certain way to get the tones. It's like a trumpet trumpet, you can cross fingers, cross vowels to get sounds, but clarinet you can't. You have to close all the holes to get the desired notes. Then Eddie Miller came along, he was a youngster, he was a little younger than I, and he started playing and he had a world of talent. So we started playing together and then Doc Rando, who also played…
What was the first job you ever played, even without pay?
